title: Idempotency-Key on asset create — replay returns stored response, no duplicate
objective: Verify POST /assets with an Idempotency-Key, when retried (network retry/double submit), returns the originally recorded response and creates exactly one asset.
preconditions: Operator session; Cycle-2 idempotency implementation merged (ADR-004 closure).
test_data: valid asset payload; key K1; same payload replayed with K1 twice (sequential + parallel)
steps: POST /assets with Idempotency-Key K1 → record 201 body (asset uuid, warnings).
Replay identical request with K1 → compare status/body.
Fire parallel duplicate requests with K1 (pytest threads).
Count assets with the generated tag/serial.
expected_result: Replays return the recorded response (same asset uuid + warnings); exactly one Asset, one initial LifecycleEvent, one AuditEvent; parallel attempts serialized safely.

title: Idempotency-Key conflict — same key, different payload
objective: Verify reusing a key with a different request body is rejected (request_hash mismatch) rather than silently returning the old response.
preconditions: Completed request with key K2 on asset create.
steps: POST /assets with K2 and altered body.
expected_result: 409 (or documented 4xx) with a stable code indicating idempotency-key reuse with different payload; no new asset created; original record unaffected.

title: Idempotency-Key supported on all lifecycle/transition endpoints
objective: Verify assign, transfer, return, reserve/checkout, report-exception, stocktake observation, and import commit all honor Idempotency-Key (replay-safe).
preconditions: Fixtures for each workflow (assignable asset, transferable asset, active assignment, reservable asset, started stocktake, validated import).
test_data: unique key per endpoint; each request executed then replayed with same key
steps: For each endpoint: execute with key, replay with same key, verify single side effect (one assignment close/open pair, one transfer, one return, one observation, one import commit).
Verify key scoping: same key on a different endpoint or different user is treated as distinct (per user+endpoint scoping).
expected_result: Every retry-sensitive POST is replay-safe with exactly-once side effects; keys scoped per user+endpoint; 24h TTL behavior documented (expiry test optional/manual if time-mocking unavailable).

title: Frontend unsafe-retry policy — no blind retries without Idempotency-Key
objective: Verify the useApi client never auto-retries unsafe methods without attaching an Idempotency-Key, and attaches correlation IDs on all requests (design §8.4).
test_data: mocked fetch failing once with network error on POST /assets and GET /assets
steps: Inspect/run frontend unit tests covering useApi retry policy.
Verify GET retries with backoff; POST without key does not retry; POST with key retries safely.
Verify X-Correlation-ID header present on every request.
expected_result: Retry policy implemented exactly per §8.4; tests green; correlation ID UUIDv4 per request.
